sloka: तस्मान्निर्यात्यतां सीता विवरं वा प्रयच्छ मे ।पाताले नाकपृष्ठे वा वसेयं सहितस्तया ।। ७.९८.८ ॥
transliteration: tasmānniryātyatāṁ sītā vivaraṁ vā prayaccha me ।pātāle nākapṛṣṭhe vā vaseyaṁ sahitastayā ।। 7.98.8 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, bring forth Sita, or grant me an opening, so that I may dwell with her either in the netherworld or on the surface of heaven.
